g.text: F2 Synchronization interval, overlap and first conflicts
Dashed first-order model: C(n,2)pλ²τ, for zero avoidance/dependency; applies only to overlap pairs.
95% normal intervals across available seeds. Conflict size excludes seeds with no conflict; actual n is in the full table.
